Photo 1 shows the same console and controller with the controller rotated; same camo wrap and bedspread; watermark reads POSTED ON JIJI STEVAN ZIDIRI.
Photo 2 shows the same console and controller in the original position; no new angles or details.
No game discs, cases, box, receipt, or power-on test is shown in any photo.

response.reason: The photos show a camouflage-wrapped PlayStation 4 console with a controller; because no games, box, or power-on test is shown, it is priced at its worst case as a non-working, unhacked console without games.
